entities.name: Hasan ibn Zayd
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Abū Muḥammad al-Ḥasan ibn Zayd ibn Muḥammad ibn Ismaʿīl ibn al-Ḥasan ibn Zayd, also known as al-Dāʿī al-Kabīr, was an Alid who became the founder of the Zaydid dynasty of Tabaristan.
